_readme: Additives that can come from plants OR animals. Food Lens shows each one it finds, with what it is and whether the source is known.
terms: matched like the rules file ('=word' = whole word). E-numbers without spaces ('e471'); labels writing 'E 471' or 'E-471' are normalised.
group: which rule group in ingredient-rules.json this additive belongs to, so a known source can settle that rule's 'Unclear'.
veganClaimSettles: true when a 'vegan' label on the product is enough to know the source is not animal.
This is general background, not a guarantee for any single product.

additives.name: Glycerin
additives.about: A sweet, thick liquid that keeps food moist. Made from plant oils or animal fat.

additives.name: Salts of fatty acids
additives.about: Emulsifier and anti-caking agent. The fatty acids come from plant oils or animal fat.

additives.name: Mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids
additives.about: The most common emulsifier, in bread, ice cream and margarine. Usually made from palm, soy or rapeseed oil, but can be made from animal fat.

additives.name: Esters of mono- and diglycerides
additives.about: Emulsifiers made from E471 and a food acid. Same question: plant oil or animal fat.

additives.name: Sucrose esters of fatty acids
additives.about: Emulsifier made from sugar and fatty acids from plant oil or animal fat.

additives.name: Sucroglycerides
additives.about: Emulsifier made from sugar and fats, which can be plant or animal.

additives.name: Polyglycerol esters of fatty acids
additives.about: Emulsifier used in cakes and baked goods. Fatty acids from plant oil or animal fat.

additives.name: Propylene glycol esters of fatty acids
additives.about: Emulsifier for whipped toppings and cakes. Fatty acids from plant oil or animal fat.

additives.name: Sodium stearoyl-2-lactylate
additives.about: Dough conditioner in bread and buns. Made from lactic acid and stearic acid, which can be plant or animal.

additives.name: Calcium stearoyl-2-lactylate
additives.about: Dough conditioner like E481. Stearic acid from plant or animal fat.

additives.name: Stearyl tartrate
additives.about: Dough improver. The fat part can be plant or animal.

additives.name: Sorbitan esters
additives.about: Emulsifiers in yeast, cakes and toppings. Fatty acids from plant oil or animal fat.

additives.name: Stearic acid
additives.about: A fatty acid used as an anti-caking and coating agent. From plant oil or animal fat.

additives.name: Magnesium stearate
additives.about: Anti-caking agent, common in tablets and sweets. Stearic acid from plant or animal fat.

additives.name: Disodium guanylate
additives.about: Flavour enhancer in crisps and instant noodles. Made from yeast or by fermentation, sometimes from fish.

additives.name: Disodium inosinate
additives.about: Flavour enhancer often paired with E627. Traditionally from meat or fish, today often from fermentation.

additives.name: Disodium ribonucleotides
additives.about: A mix of E627 and E631; the same plant-or-animal question.

additives.name: L-cysteine
additives.about: Flour treatment agent in bread. Can be made from feathers or hair, or by fermentation.

additives.name: L-cystine
additives.about: Related to E920, with the same possible animal origin.

additives.name: Vitamin D3
additives.about: Usually made from lanolin in sheep's wool (vegetarian, not vegan); plant versions come from lichen.

additives.name: Shellac
additives.about: A shiny glaze made from a resin that lac insects produce. No plant version exists.
